fields.informations_diverses: Date, 1913 (Eth. Cal.), i.e. 1920-1921. Vellum, codex. 28.5 x 20.5 x 7 cm; 248 folios; full binding. Wooden boards covered with red leather beautifully decorated with various geometrical designs also of the crosses that appear on both covers. 2 columns; 20-26 lines per column; Ms. in excellent condition.
fields.contenu: Title: The Epistles of the New Testament; The Book of Acts; The Book of Revelation. 1) fols. 3-14. Introduction to the *Epistles of Paul* giving the reasons why and the conditions under which they were written, a kind of brief commentary. 2) fols. 17-40a. Epistle to the Romans. 3) fols. 40a-63a. Ist Epistle to the Corinthians. 4) fols. 63a-78a. IInd Epistle to the Corinthians. 5) fols. 78a-85a. Epistle to the Galatians. 6) fols. 85a-91b. Epistle to the Ephesians. 7) fols. 91b-96a. Epistle to the Philippians. 8) fols. 96a-100b. Epistle to the Colossians. 9) fols. 100b-105a. Ist Epistle to the Thessalonians. 10) fols. 105a-107a. IInd Epistle to the Thessalonians. 11) fols. 107a-112b. Ist Epistle to Timothy. 12) fols. 112b-116b. IInd Epistle to Timothy. 13) fols. 116b-118b. Epistle to Titus. 14) fols. 118b-119b. Epistle to Philemon. 15) fols. 119b-134b. Epistle to the Hebrews. 16) fols. 137-143b. Ist Epistle of Peter. 17) fols. 143b-147a. IInd Epistle of Peter. 18) fols. 147a-153a. Ist Epistle of John. 19) fols. 153a-154a. IInd Epistle of John. 20) fols. 154a-154b. IIIrd Epistle of John. 21) fols. 154b-160a. Epistle of James. 22) fols. 160a-161. Epistle of Juda. 23) fols. 162-186b. Book of Revelation (Apocalypse of John). 24) fols. 186b-241a. Book of Acts of The Apostles.
